primary_endpoint: At Week 48, percentage achieving ≥1-stage fibrosis improvement without worsening of NASH; TEAEs and treatment-emergent laboratory abnormalities through 48 weeks plus 30 days.
efficacy_outcome: At Week 48, fibrosis improvement without worsening of NASH occurred in 11.8%–28.6% across active groups versus 10.5% with placebo. Reported Mantel–Haenszel p-values were all nonsignificant (range 0.1658–0.9646).
safety_signal: TEAEs occurred in 84.6%–96.1% of active-treatment participants versus 79.5% with placebo; treatment-emergent laboratory abnormalities occurred in 94.9%–100.0% versus 94.9%. Serious AEs affected 3/40–10/77 participants in active groups and 2/39 with placebo; one death occurred in the selonsertib plus cilofexor group.
